objective: Establish the governed news source, license, attribution and admissibility policy for P11 with deterministic offline validation, point-in-time provenance and fail-closed rumor controls.
scope: Define canonical news source classes and source identity
Define access, license, attribution, retention and redistribution states
Require explicit source URL/domain, observed-at and published-at semantics
Define admissibility states for confirmed, corroborated, single-source and unconfirmed claims
Require community/social content to remain unconfirmed until corroborated by admissible evidence
Forbid unconfirmed news from creating trade authority
Activate P11 and reconcile GitHub/Linear task and lock state
out_of_scope: Selecting or purchasing a production news vendor
Signal fusion, risk approval, broker/exchange execution or order placement
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P11 source-policy product source/tests
Unknown source class/access/license/admissibility values fail closed
Source identity is deterministic and content-sensitive
HTTPS source URL and normalized hostname are mandatory
Community/social sources cannot be CONFIRMED without corroboration
UNCONFIRMED content cannot grant trade authority
Policy permits no direct trade/order authority fields
P11-A evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No production news vendor is selected
No network call is required by canonical tests
rollback: Revert P11-A policy/module/tests/evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P10 remains canonical and no production credential/network/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Attribution and admissibility semantics fail closed
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
